evidence.quote: Today I am excited to announce the Federal Reserve will invest in a new service to help ensure that real-time payments are available to everyone.
The Federal Reserve will develop the FedNow Service SM , a real-time payment and settlement service for the future.
Safety is also vital. If the Federal Reserve does not establish the FedNow Service, there will be a single provider of real-time retail payment services.
